plan.confidence_note: Every step below is a timer or rule in the bot's settings, and the bot is healthy. Nothing needs you.

sections.title: Right now
lines: Pregame build. Kickoff Thu 7:15 PM CT (in 13h 13m).
Sold 3,018 contracts so far. 2,920 more are resting on the book, on 6 of 6 sides.
By team: DEN 1,719, SEA 1,299.
Not balanced yet: the worst line is -$606; the goal is -$150 or better by kickoff, so $456 to close.
If every resting order filled, the worst line would be -$109.
Backstop is ON: DEN by 1-6 is the heaviest side and has stopped adding until the others catch up.
Bot is healthy: heartbeat 36s old, no errors.

sections.title: Lagging sides
lines: DEN by 15+: sold 200, 996 behind the leader. Cheapest row is 10c, fair 9.4c. It can step down 1c at a time, to no lower than about 6.4c (never under the crowd's clearing price or fair minus 3c), after 20 min with no fill, at most one step per 15 min. Last price step: 16h 36m ago. Next possible step now, if nothing has filled.

SEA by 7-14: sold 222, 973 behind the leader. Cheapest row is 20c, crowd has been buying at 20c, fair 18.6c. It is already at its floor (about 20c), so it will not go lower unless the crowd price or fair drops. Last hold reason (5h 10m ago): filling one more row in full would push the worst line to -$171, so the bot holds its price.

DEN by 7-14: sold 324, 872 behind the leader. Cheapest row is 15c, fair 14.4c. It can step down 1c at a time, to no lower than about 11.4c (never under the crowd's clearing price or fair minus 3c), after 20 min with no fill, at most one step per 15 min. Last price step: 15h 23m ago. Next possible step now, if nothing has filled.

SEA by 15+: sold 450, 746 behind the leader. Cheapest row is 18c, crowd has been buying at 18c, fair 15.2c. It is already at its floor (about 18c), so it will not go lower unless the crowd price or fair drops. Last hold reason (5h 10m ago): filling one more row in full would push the worst line to -$171, so the bot holds its price.

SEA by 1-6: sold 627, 569 behind the leader. Cheapest row is 26c, crowd has been buying at 26c, fair 22.2c. It is already at its floor (about 26c), so it will not go lower unless the crowd price or fair drops.

The bot looks at lagging sides every loop (1m) and takes a fresh market snapshot about every 10 min (last one 38s ago). Rows already resting are not repriced when the sportsbook line moves; only new rows use the fresh fair.
A step is skipped if filling the new row in full would push the worst line lower.

sections.title: Next wave of contracts
lines: A side gets a new batch when its resting drops under 25% of what it launched with. The batch is 50% of the launch size (a third inside T-30), split 60/25/15 at +0/+1/+2c, priced from the last hour's fills.
Closest to triggering: SEA by 7-14 with 827 resting against a trigger of 225 (launch 900). That is far from the trigger.
DEN by 1-6 is thin (75 resting) but is 1,196 contracts ahead of the least-sold side (limit 300), so it gets no batch until the others catch up.
The worst-line gate is closed: batches only post while the worst line is -$200 or better, and it is -$606 now. So no new batch posts until fills lift the worst line.
Limits: up to 3 batches per side, 20 minutes apart, until T-3. Batches used so far: none.
A lagging side with nothing resting would get a catch-up batch sized to its gap. None is empty now.
Held back and not yet posted: DEN by 7-14: 53 contracts. The bot releases these when the batch cap and cash allow; I cannot see the exact moment.

sections.title: Tightening
lines: Trickle balancing (paid) starts at T-240: Thu 3:15 PM CT (in 9h 13m). The bot notes the worst line then, and walks it in a straight line to -$150 by T-10 (Thu 7:05 PM CT).
Rules: checks every 5 min, pays only when more than $25 behind the path, never on the most-held side, clips of up to 100 contracts, no more than $100 total paid per book. Spent so far: $0.
From T-30 (Thu 6:45 PM CT): if the worst line is -$150 or better, paid balancing stops for good; new offers keep going until kickoff.
Checkpoints (a market snapshot is logged each time): T-240, T-180, T-120, T-90, T-60, T-30.
At kickoff (Thu 7:15 PM CT) the in-game engine takes over and keeps the resting orders.

sections.title: Will it adapt on its own?
lines: Yes, on its own: lagging sides step their price down within the limits above; thin sides get new batches while the worst-line gate is open; paid balancing follows the timer.
No, it will not: reprice rows that are already resting when the sportsbook line moves, react to injury news, or cut a side that is selling fast. Check the line yourself on Wed/Thu if news breaks.

The one thing that depends on the crowd: the worst line is -$606 against a -$150 goal. Fills on the lagging sides lift it for free; if they do not come, the paid trickle covers the rest from T-240, up to $100.
I only read the bot's settings, state and log. I cannot see its next decision, only the rules it follows.
